title: Подозрительная женщина в зале  (The Suspicious Woman in the Dining Room)

segments.t: To keep Elena from talking to the stranger he pointed out, Chef Barinov approaches the guest's table and whispers a warning that the woman in the sea-green dress by the kitchen is a suspected con artist.
Вы не знакомы с женщиной у кухни?
Ни в коем случае не общайтесь с ней.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'I am the head chef of this restaurant.' The grammar packs 'I' and 'restaurant' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Does everything suit you?' Chef Barinov anchors the line on 'you', while 'suits' completes the thought. the guest answers right away.
'Thank you, everything is very delicious.' In Russian, the idea of 'thank you' flows naturally into 'deliciously' without extra filler words.
'Turn around carefully.' In Russian, the idea of 'carefully' flows naturally into 'turn around' without extra filler words.
Вы не знакомы с женщиной у кухни?
'Are you not acquainted with the woman by the kitchen?' The grammar packs 'you' and 'kitchen' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange. the guest answers right away.
'No, I am seeing her for the first time.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'no' before landing on 'see'.
'Stay far away from her.' The grammar packs 'stick' and 'further away' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
Ни в коем случае не общайтесь с ней.
'Under no circumstances talk to her.' Chef Barinov anchors the line on 'not even', while 'her' completes the thought. the guest answers right away.
'What, is she some kind of swindler?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'and' before landing on 'con artist'.
'We are not sure, we suspect so.' The meaning hinges on 'we' working together with 'suspect' in spoken Russian.
'I talked to her, she does not want to meet.' The negative particle sits right before the verb meaning 'to have a talk' to negate the statement. Elena answers right away.
'Very sad, I will go then.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'very' and finishing on 'will go'. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
Вы не знакомы с женщиной у кухни?
Ни в коем случае не общайтесь с ней.
Hurt by Victor's endless evasions, Elena turns and walks out of the restaurant, prompting Barinov to chase after her and finally confess. See you in the next scene.
